entities.name: Ahmed Raza Khan Barelvi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ahmed Raza Khan Barelvi was an Indian Islamic scholar who is considered as one of the founders of the Barelvi movement. His students include Amjad Ali Aazmi, Abdul Aleem Siddiqi, Ziauddin Madani and several others.
